# Properties response vectors
# Source: midea-msmart @ d7db53bc470d3751b3f29a5ca2fedacdd4d14b70 msmart/device/AC/test_command.py TestPropertiesResponse/TestResponseConstruct
# The props_ieco_*/props_outsilent_*/props_pair/props_zero_len*/props_truncated
# frames are synthesized device answers (no upstream capture exists), built
# with the pinned msmart's Frame + crc8 over IECO/OUT_SILENT TLVs; decode
# expectations follow PropertiesResponse._parse and PropertyId.decode.
# Format: column-0 line = vector name; indented `field value` lines follow.
# Hex values are lowercase. Do not edit by hand; re-run the extractor.

props_parsing
  # test_properties_parsing; 0x0009/0x000A, includes unsupported INDOOR_HUMIDITY
  frame aa21ac00000000000303b10409000001000a00000100150000012b1e020000005fa3
  expect_swing_lr 0
  expect_swing_ud 0
  expect_ieco none
  expect_out_silent none
  expect_self_clean none
  expect_breeze_away none
  expect_breezeless none
  expect_flash none

  expect_swing_ud 0
  expect_ieco none
  expect_out_silent none

props_ieco_failed
  # synthesized 0xB0 ack with execution-failed bit 0x11; value still decoded, as upstream

  expect_ieco 1

  expect_out_silent none

props_zero_len_then_outsilent
  # zero-length IECO TLV is skipped; the walk continues into the next TLV
  frame aa16ac00000000000003b102e3000000cd0000010306ce
  expect_ieco none
  expect_out_silent 1
  expect_out_silent_failed 0

props_truncated
  # C++-hardened: TLV shorter than its length header; walk stops (upstream raises)
  frame aa12ac00000000000003b101e3000002008c1c
  expect_ieco none
  expect_out_silent none

props_buzzer_then_out_silent
  # BUZZER (0x001A) has no decoder (msmart decode returns None): the TLV must
  # be skipped without desyncing the walk; the out-silent behind it lands.
  frame aa17ac00000000000003b1021a00000101cd000001035347
  expect_out_silent 1

props_buzzer_failed
  # set ack for the buzzer: result bit 0x10; nothing decodes from it.
  frame aa12ac00000000000002b0011a001101005013
  expect_ieco none
